messages:
maya: Quick accessibility sweep on the new Metrics panel — focus states, keyboard tab order, color contrast, and ARIA roles. Prototype: https://www.figma.com/file/abcd1234. Please review, especially the muted labels. :eyes:
noah: looked briefly — the small gray numbers (token counts) are around #6b6b6b on white; WCAG AA needs 4.5:1, so that's a fail. I ran a quick check with the ColourContrastAnlyzr plugin.
frank: confirmed. failing contrast for 'subtle' label. Suggest switching to `text-subtle-strong` token or #444444. Also we should add a visible focus ring for keyboard users — current outline is too thin.
zoe: keyboard nav issue: tabbing jumps from the main chart straight to the footer skip link — tab order seems wrong. Repro in Chrome + NVDA. Are we missing proper landmarks/regions?
accessibility-bot: automated scan results: contrast: 3 fails, focus indicators: 2 fails, ARIA missing on 1 interactive icon button. Full log uploaded to the channel.
maya: thanks. For focus ring proposal, here's a quick style we can standardize on:
```
.button:focus-visible {
  outline: 3px solid var(--interactive-strong);
  outline-offset: 2px;
  border-radius: 4px;
}
```
frank: also for SVG icon buttons ensure `focusable="true"` + `tabindex="0"` and a descriptive `aria-label`. Many icons are not reachable by keyboard right now.
noah: for the chart tooltip, add `role="tooltip"` and use `aria-live="polite"` when the tooltip content updates dynamically so screen readers announce it.
zoe: +1. Also propose adding a visible "Skip to content" link that appears on focus at the very top of the console: `a.skip-to-content` that becomes visible when focused. That helps keyboard-only users jump past nav.
maya: I'll make a quick PR with: color swaps for failing tokens, the focus CSS, SVG fixes, skip link, and notes in the component docs about tab order. Targeting EOD for a first pass.
noah: can you include screenshots of the failing states in the PR? that speeds review.
maya: will attach screenshots and the accessibility-bot report.
frank: small nit — avoid dashed outlines; prefer a solid 3px per design tokens (clean and high contrast). :white_check_mark: 
zoe: happy to smoke-test with NVDA on Monday and validate the tab order changes.
maya: great, thanks. tagging @sam for confirmation on shipping behind a feature flag.
sam: pref for behind flag so we can rollout and monitor. Go ahead.
maya: cool, I'll add the flag, link the PR here, and include a short QA checklist (contrast checks, focus tab flow, aria labels). :shipit:
